images.filename: First ARRA-Funded Demolition Takes Down Last Building in “Engineering Row” (7582957250).jpg
images.caption:
It’s not often one project represents both a first and a last milestone, but this week the demolition of Building 9735 at Y-12 National Security Complex did just that.
The demolition of Building 9735, the first Y‑12 demolition project funded by the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act (ARRA), started Monday, Feb. 8, and was completed the same day.

“The waste will be disposed of in the coming weeks, and the entire project will be completed four months ahead of schedule,” said Jim Blair, B&W Y-12’s project manager for ARRA deactivation and demolition (D&D) projects at the site.
